notes: A new glass look (Settings → Style, Classic still there) and a side menu that tucks away when you're not using it. In Live TV, Left shows the channels over the picture and Left again the groups in their place; the guide and Live TV keep the same group. The guide can be compact like TiviMate (Settings → Guide layout) and shows a programme's picture and details when you rest on it. Search finds titles however they're typed, live channels keep retrying when a provider refuses them, and a playback log (Settings) helps track down streams that fail.
